VehicleCommandCenter is the Vehicle Commands control surface: a vehicle header, a last-command result banner, an asleep guard, a stale-data warning, a command search box, a Quick-Actions favorites bar, the command catalogue (flat search grid OR collapsible category groups), and the three centralised command dialogs (input/select/confirm).

No DOM / lucide-react / Recharts / Leaflet / react-i18next / old web-UI imports reach the native output — only react, react-native primitives (View/Pressable/TextInput/ScrollView/Modal/ActivityIndicator/Alert/StyleSheet), react-query, the canonical AppText + SemanticIcon, the native GlassPanel, the native request client + useSettings, the reused CommandSearch and theme tokens. window.localStorage/sessionStorage are the only browser-only behaviours and are replaced by a documented native-safe in-memory session store (no explicit 'unavailable' UI state is required because favorites/collapse still function in-session).
